subject: Service restitution & consolidated credit plan for migration overcharges
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver@springwillow.io>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: billing@springwillow.io
Date: 2027-02-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Unexpected billing after migration - need consolidated remediation

Hi Priyom,

We finished our migration to Redwood Dedicated at the end of November and have since seen a series of micro-charges and a spike in token consumption that don't match our internal usage reports. Our finance team pulled the attached invoice bundle (Q4-2026) and flagged 3 invoices where the per-hour metering looks doubled for several days.

We'd like to avoid 10 separate small credits. Can Redwood provide a consolidated remediation plan (total credit, timing) and clear guidance on VAT treatment for a UK-based customer (SpringWillow Ltd)? Also, please advise whether you can apply the credit against our outstanding February invoice or issue a credit note.

Thanks,
Oliver
Head of Procurement
SpringWillow Health
Phone: +44 20 7946 0912

Attachment: invoice_bundle_SpringWillow_Q4-2026.zip (zip of PDFs)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@springwillow.io>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2027-02-02T11:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected billing after migration - need consolidated remediation

Hi Oliver — thanks for the clear packet. I'm sorry for the friction here.

What I can do right away:
- Provisionally reserve a consolidated credit equal to the disputed line totals while we reconcile (I need the line-level PDF pages you marked; your bundle helps).
- Coordinate with Billing (cc'd) to check metering events and whether autoscaling burst recorded differently during the migration window.
- Outline a single credit note that covers the three invoices and a goodwill concession to make this whole correction a single transaction.

Can you confirm: 1) you want the credit applied to the Feb 2027 invoice, or issued as a standalone credit note; 2) whether SpringWillow will provide VAT registration docs for the UK entity (we may need to reverse-charge depending on the invoicing country).

I attached a draft restitution schedule (high level) and will ask Karhtik to validate amounts. If all good, we'll get a credit note out within 7 business days and target clearing the Feb invoice before due date.

Best,
Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
pri_yom@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

Attachment: redwood_credit_schedule.xlsx (draft schedule - provisional amounts)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Oliver Grant <oliver@springwillow.io>
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2027-02-03T08:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected billing after migration - need consolidated remediation

Hi Oliver,

Thanks for sending the bundle and thanks Priyom for the heads-up. I pulled the metering logs for Nov 28 - Dec 04 and see two separate bursts: one correlated with the migration traffic and one anomalous multi-hour spike on Nov 30 that appears to be double-counted due to a transient agent retry loop. We'll remove the duplicate token tallies tied to the retry loop and generate corrected lines.

VAT/tax note: SpringWillow Ltd is UK-registered per the domain, so we need a copy of your UK VAT Certificate or VAT registration number to support a zero-rated reverse-charge application on our invoice (if you're registered and the service qualifies). If you can't provide that, we'll issue a normal VAT-inclusive credit note and refund.

Next steps I propose:
1) We will issue an interim provisional credit equal to the three disputed invoice lines (line totals listed in the attached provisional schedule).
2) Final reconciliation after you confirm VAT docs; final credit note will either show reverse-charge (0% VAT) or include VAT depending on the evidence.
3) Provisional credit can be applied to Feb invoice now; final credit note will reconcile any delta.

I've attached the uk_vat_certificate.pdf example we need (you can redact unrelated info). Once we have that, we can close this. Planning: 5 business days to issue provisional credit, 7-10 business days for final credit note after docs.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Manager, Billing Operations | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Attachment: uk_vat_certificate.pdf (template: please attach your VAT registration doc)

From: Oliver Grant <oliver@springwillow.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: billing@springwillow.io
Date: 2027-02-05T10:21:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected billing after migration - need consolidated remediation

Got it — thanks Karthik/Priyom.

We can provide the VAT reg doc and have attached the redacted UK VAT certificate to this reply. Our controller also asked whether Redwood can route the provisional credit to the February invoice; that would help cashflow on our side.

One ask from procurement: given the operational impact, can Redwood include a small goodwill credit on top of the direct correction? It doesn't need to be large — enough to cover our controller's administrative time and to signal this won't happen again. If you can propose a figure, we'll accept it.

I'm also starting the DocuSign for the amended SOW (link below) so we can finalize the commercial terms we discussed.

Thanks,
Oliver
Attachment: springwillow_uk_vat_cert_redacted.pdf
Related link: https://www.docusign.com/transaction/ABC123456789

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@springwillow.io>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2027-02-07T15:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected billing after migration - need consolidated remediation

Oliver — appreciate the quick turnaround on the VAT doc and the DocuSign start. Final plan below (confirming in one thread):

1) Provisional consolidated credit: GBP 18,640 applied to Feb 2027 invoice immediately (credit memo issued same day).
2) Goodwill concession: additional GBP 1,100 credited as a one-time service restitution line.
3) Final reconciliation: after billing validates corrected metering logs (we expect a net adjustment within +/- GBP 250), we'll issue a final credit note showing reverse-charge (0% VAT) per the supplied UK VAT certificate. If anything changes we'll do a net settlement; no cash outflow unless SpringWillow requests refund.
4) Timeline: provisional credit memo issued 2027-02-07; final credit note targeted by 2027-02-14 pending internal validation.
5) Attachment: redwood_credit_schedule.xlsx contains line detail and amounts with trace back to invoice pages.

Next actions for SpringWillow: sign the DocuSign amendment to lock the updated SOW terms; confirm acceptance of the provisional credit application to Feb invoice.

I'll route the signed credit note to billing@springwillow.io and cc your controller once finalized. Thanks for working through this—we'll follow up if any reconciliation deltas appear.

Best regards,
Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
pri_yom@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

Attachments: redwood_credit_schedule.xlsx, invoice_bundle_SpringWillow_Q4-2026.zip
